test_DTWCPDDetector_spike_detection: test DTWCPDDetector to detect change points from a clear spike in zero-valued time series data
test_DTWCPDDetector_no_change_points: test DTWCPDDetector returns an empty list when no change points exist in flat zero data
test_DTWCPDDetector_multiple_series: test DTWCPDDetector identifies the most significant change point across multiple time series with spikes
test_DTWDistance: test the DTWCPDDetector.DTWDistance static method to compute dynamic time warping distance between two sequences
test_LB_Keogh: test the DTWCPDDetector.LB_Keogh static method to compute the LB Keogh lower bound for two sequences
